# SYN-NOTICE-002 — current synthetic context

All IDs and source are synthetic. Authority baseline: spec-1 as amended by confirmation-2. D1–D5 are active. D6 is settled by confirmation-2: past dates are permitted because expiry is recorded for later manual review. No auto-send, automatic deletion or new permissions are authorized.

The existing source stores body and group, with no expiry storage. A persistent optional date needs a database design change. Nullable DATE is one proposed representation, not business-mandated SQL. Existing drafts require absence semantics; published state and recipient ownership must remain unchanged. The environment's actual schema/population has not been observed. No real counts, migration execution or performance claims are available.
